Promotes 'SendGrid generic-key control detects the entire token, including a trailing dash' out of redact-secret-benchmarks' regressions.test.mjs (benchmarks issue #16), which pins two properties across the corpus's three '-generic-key' fixtures: a secret segment ending in '-' and an id/secret pair carrying an embedded '_'. Each property got its own canonical fixture per the split-by-property rule so a failure names which one broke. Both were confirmed to already pass against the current detector before being added, so this closes an uncovered contract rather than a live regression; gates stay pending until supported-surface evidence and a fixed-candidate benchmark rerun are recorded. No benchmark fixture input or discovery-matrix material was copied -- both canonical inputs are freshly constructed synthetic values.

Promotes 'positive reference controls remain detectable by the public npm surface' out of redact-secret-benchmarks' regressions.test.mjs (benchmarks issue #16).
